notes: ARCHETYPE: copy with `lotr template new NAME --archetype stdio-docker`, then replace every TODO.
`-e NAME` (no value) makes docker pass that variable from LOTR's environment into the container; the value comes from env_refs and is never in the command line.
Use a tag or digest (image@sha256:...), not `latest`. Docker must be running.
-i keeps stdin open (MCP over stdio); --rm removes the container when it stops.
